definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese food made from soybeans fermented with Bacillus subtilis, known for its strong smell and sticky, stringy texture.

notes:
A highly nutritious food rich in protein, vitamin K2, and probiotics. Typically eaten for breakfast with rice, often with:
- ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧ or ⟦{付属|ふぞく}→付属：27518_fuzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦タレ→タレ：10500_tare⟧ (soy sauce or included sauce)
- ⟦からし→からし：28711_karashi⟧ (mustard)
- ⟦ねぎ→葱：05189_negi⟧ (green onion)
- ⟦{生卵|なまたまご}→生卵：19011_namatamago⟧ (raw egg)

The stringy texture is called ⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (drawing threads). Regional specialty of ⟦{水戸|みと}→水戸：28730_mito⟧ in Ibaraki Prefecture. Opinions are divided - some love it, others can't stand it (⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦{嫌|きら}い→嫌い：02871_kirai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かれる→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧).
